topic: Analytics dashboard access and inventory visibility
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on technical issues within the analytics platform, specifically regarding user roles and data visibility for client accounts. Initially, a link was flagged where an unnecessary 'Mall' role was present for a specific client ([email@jcdecaux.com]), which was subsequently agreed to be removed.

Regarding inventory access, it was noted that while clients should ideally see the inventory, the current admin view only shows data without impersonation. A workaround/solution was suggested: users must log in as an administrator and then use the 'impersonate' function within the inventory section to view client-specific data.

The direct URL for accessing the general inventory page was provided.
decisions: The unnecessary 'Mall' role associated with the specified client was removed from the analytics platform.
action_items: Someone needs to implement a proper solution for viewing client data within the inventory section (impersonation functionality).
